From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Barnes <rachel@sunriseai.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: PO vs Card and vendor onboarding — next steps for SunriseAI

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the clarity on your use case and expected monthly token volume. Quick recap and a few asks so we can map the right commercial path: 

- Procurement preference: you mentioned AP prefers issuing a PO (Net30) for new vendors but the team sometimes uses the company corporate card for pilot spend.
- Marketplace interest: your platform team asked whether Redwood is available in the major cloud marketplaces (GCP/AWS) to simplify procurement.
- Security/compliance: you said your security team will need vendor onboarding materials (W9, SOC 2 summary, insurance certificate).

To move forward, can you confirm: 
1) Who on your procurement team should I loop in (name + email)?
2) Is a PO required for any dollar threshold (e.g., >$10k)?
3) Would SunriseAI consider starting on a card for a 30–60 day pilot and then convert to PO for production?

I've attached a draft SOW and a short vendor onboarding checklist to speed the AP process. If it helps, we can also open a Marketplace intake — that can remove the PO entirely depending on your finance policy.

Next step from my side: I'll pull Monica (CS) into the thread to confirm onboarding steps and Marissa (sales manager) if we need to escalate for PO exceptions.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Barnes <rachel@sunriseai.com>

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO vs Card and vendor onboarding — next steps for SunriseAI

Diego —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- Supplier setup: We require a completed vendor onboarding form (we've attached our standard to procurement@sunriseai.com). Should include W9 and company insurance info.
- PO policy: Anything above $5k requires a PO. For pilots under $5k teams can typically use the corp card.
- Marketplace: We prefer marketplace buys for SaaS when available because it eases invoices and tax handling, but it requires the vendor to be listed (we can accept both vendor-managed marketplace entries and marketplace-managed billing).

For now: loop in Maria (procurement@sunriseai.com) — she'll confirm exact documentation. We are open to starting on a card up to $5k to accelerate the pilot. If the expected first month spend is higher, we'll need a PO.

Rachel Barnes
Head of Platform Partnerships | SunriseAI

Hi Maria / Rachel —

Thanks for confirming the $5k threshold; that helps. From an onboarding perspective we typically need 3 items to get a team running within 2–3 business days after vendor setup: 

• Signed SOW or PO (SOW + PO preferred for production)
• Completed vendor onboarding form with W9 and COI (certificate of insurance)
• Primary admin user and team seat count for initial provisioning

If SunriseAI wants to kick off a quick pilot on a card for under $5k, Monica (me) can provision a short-lived test environment and share instructions. If you need an expedited PO we can request a one-time PO exception — Marissa can advise on credit or pilot credits while procurement completes setup.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Maria: send preferred vendor onboarding form version or confirm we can use the attached 1-pager.
2) Rachel: confirm if you want to start on card for initial pilot (yes/no) and an expected first-month spend number.
3) Diego/Marissa: will raise PO exception if team requests pilot credits.

Thanks — looking forward to getting SunriseAI into the platform.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
